source_audits.summary: A previous handoff package described a different delivery identity.
Legacy-only listing fallback was replaced by a generic marker despite the canonical fallback contract.
ADR/API documentation did not consistently state legacy fallback and structured precedence.
No explicit contradictory hybrid fixture proved structured identifiers win over legacy text.

controls.evidence: Canonical specification snapshot identifies the current repository and issue; terminal result-only child is required to use this material head as its direct parent.
Published renderer restores the trimmed legacy maskedIdentifier only when structured identifiers are absent; updated regression asserts the recognizable fallback.
Updated regression contains deliberately conflicting structured and legacy values and requires structured suffixes while rejecting legacy presentation.
API_ACCOUNTS.md and ADR 0012 now state identical structured-precedence and legacy-only fallback semantics.
